desc_en: Ivory grip with inlaid dot/rosette pins, gold-koftgari pommel cap, wire-bound ferrule, plain steel cross guard; black tooled leather scabbard with silver lockets (pierced tops) and pierced gilt chape; gold lobed cartouche at forte
evidence: Closest S-J-021 (ivory, pins, black tooled scabbard, gold cartouche) rejected: S-J-021 has plain grip with steel cap, engraved guard, copper-toned chape; S-J-002 rejected (fluted ivory).

evidence: 96 cartouche shows the fuller slot seen in 94/97 (DSC 5738 between 5725 and 5740). S-J-007 rejected (finger-grooved wavy grip with star inlay, different guard); S-J-026 rejected (dark wood grip, horse-head steel guard, full repousse scabbard).

desc_en: All-steel hilt with silver-inlaid pistol grip, steel cross guard; broad curved blade with false edge, gold-koftgari forte panel with central lion/roundel medallion and inscriptions; no scabbard

evidence: No catalog piece has the diamond-tooled scabbard with embossed copper lockets; S-J-037 (ridged brown scabbard, bone grip) rejected.

desc_en: Ivory grip painted/inlaid with orange-red floral scrolls, steel pommel cap, wire ferrule, steel cross guard; black tooled scabbard with leaf-shaped steel lockets and pinkish chape; engraved (non-gold) double cartouche; strong watered blade
evidence: S-J-035 (orange carved bone grip) rejected: carved flowers on orange ground, gold-outlined guard, brown scabbard with calligraphic lockets.

evidence: S-J-004 (silver hilt, tan leather scabbard), S-J-012 and S-J-030 (ivory grips) rejected.

desc_en: Ivory grip with dot-inlay pins and gold-koftgari pommel, long straight-quillon steel cross guard; black grooved/tooled scabbard with calligraphic steel lockets and gilt chape; two gold-outlined black cartouches ('Ali...', 'amal Muhammad...')
evidence: S-J-023/024/025/033/034/045 (calligraphic lockets) rejected: diamond/engraved guards and plain grips.
